title: iTrack Fleet Tracking
headline: Cloud fleet tracking on our own S100 tracker, with multi-GNSS positioning, dual SIM, jamming detection, driver scoring and live maps
subtitle: Fleet tracking on our own S100 and S200 trackers, with live maps, driver behaviour scoring and alerts in the cloud and on mobile
need: Fleet operators need to know where every vehicle is, how it is being driven and when something goes wrong, from theft and fuel loss to speeding and harsh braking. Many low-cost trackers lose position in cities, drop out when one mobile network is weak, and are easily defeated by jammers or a cut battery cable.
We wanted a tracker we fully control, from hardware to cloud, so it can be adapted to each fleet and integrated with other sensors.
role: SciFlair designed and owns iTrack end to end: the S100 tracker hardware and firmware, the cloud tracking platform, the web dashboard and the mobile app. It builds on what we learned from Axino.
built: S100 tracker with a 72-channel receiver that uses up to three satellite systems at once (GPS, Galileo, GLONASS, BeiDou) for accurate positions in difficult areas
Dual SIM slots with automatic changeover, so the tracker stays connected when one network is weak
GPS and GSM jamming detection, spoofing detection and a hardware encryption engine
A backup battery that keeps reporting if the vehicle battery is cut, plus a 3-axis accelerometer
Inputs and outputs for ignition, doors, seat belts, fuel and temperature sensors, and an expansion port for custom hardware
S200, a compact variant for the consumer market with two-wire power connection and revised software for personal vehicles
An Axino-based tracker build, pairing an Axino module with a GNSS board, for specialist uses that need custom sensors, radios or enclosures
A cloud dashboard and mobile app with live maps, route replay, geofences, alerts and driver performance scoring for speeding, harsh acceleration and braking

delivery.title: Concept
delivery.text: Defined the needs of fleet operators: reliable positions, constant connectivity, tamper resistance, driver behaviour and reports.

delivery.title: Development
delivery.text: Designed the S100 hardware and firmware, the tracking server and the web and mobile applications, and verified them on vehicles in daily use.

delivery.title: Production
delivery.text: Manufactured S100 boards and units in batches for fleet installations.

delivery.title: Utilisation
delivery.text: In service on vehicles, with the platform now live at itrack.uk.

delivery.title: S200 for consumers
delivery.text: In 2021 developed the S200, a smaller, easy-to-fit variant with revised software for private car owners.

delivery.title: Support
delivery.text: Supported and extended with new reports, alerts and integrations.

nextGen.title: Deploy or Back iTrack
nextGen.text: iTrack is live and ready for new fleets: logistics, public transport, construction plant, school transport, fuel tankers and cash-in-transit, with the S200 for private vehicles and Axino-based builds for specialist needs. We are looking for fleet partners and investors to scale it.
